sourceSentences: When Akali exits the ring, for 2 seconds, she regains the bonus movement speed while facing nearby enemy champions and becomes empowered with Swinging Kama for 4 seconds, during which she cannot create another ring.
Swinging Kama: Akali's next basic attack is empowered to have an uncancellable windup, gain range and deal bonus magic damage.
Enemies cannot see the ring, but can see the empower effect.
The ring will be created around the last target hit by Five Point Strike.
Akali restores 100 energy over 0.4 seconds and gains bonus movement speed that decays over 2 seconds.
Entering the shroud renders Akali invisible, unless she is dashing.
Declaring a basic attack or casting an ability will break the invisibility and prevent Akali from entering it again for seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and casts.
It is possible for Akali to detonate the smoke bomb on the far side of terrain from her current location.
The shroud does not permeate terrain, and will expand toward nearby enemy champions.
The shuriken marks and reveals the enemy or the last Twilight Shroud smoke section hit for 3 seconds, during which Shuriken Flip can be recast to consume the mark.
Twilight Shroud and Perfect Execution can be cast during the recast's dash.

Akali will dash backwards up-to 400 units in a straight line. This dash can cross terrain if the end point is beyond it. If she would end the dash inside terrain, she will instead look for a location in either direction left or right that is outside of terrain and dash there.

The shuriken missile will fire from wherever Akali is at the end of the cast time (usually mid-dash), but always towards and reaching the location that was 825 units in front of her at the start of cast. The only exception is if she moves via Flash, in which case the range of the missile is decreased relative to the distance she blinked.
Attempting to cast Five Point Strike during either dash will buffer it to cast as soon as the dash ends.
Recast: Akali dashes 800 units in the target direction, dealing magic damage to enemies she passes through, increased by % [health].
